questions.question: \(I_1 = \displaystyle\int_{0}^{\pi} \dfrac{x \sin x \, dx}{1 + \sin^2 x}\) este:
questions.author: Daniela Marian
questions.hint: \(\displaystyle I=\int_0^\pi xf(\sin x)\,dx=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}xf(\sin x)\,dx+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}xf(\sin x)\,dx\). Facem schimbarea de variabilă \(x=\pi-y\) în a doua integrală și obținem \[\begin{aligned}I&=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}xf(\sin x)\,dx+\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\pi-y)f(\sin y)\,dy\\&=\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}xf(\sin x)\,dx+\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\pi f(\sin y)\,dy-\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}yf(\sin y)\,dy\\&=\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}f(\sin x)\,dx.\end{aligned}\] Pentru calcularea integralei \(I_1\) aplicăm rezultatul de la întrebarea de mai sus și avem \[\begin{aligned}I_1&=\int_0^\pi\dfrac{x\sin x\,dx}{1+\sin^2x}=\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\dfrac{\sin x\,dx}{1+\sin^2x}=\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\dfrac{\sin x\,dx}{2-\cos^2x}\\&=\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\dfrac{-\sin x\,dx}{\cos^2x-2}=\pi\dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left|\dfrac{\cos x-\sqrt{2}}{\cos x+\sqrt{2}}\right|\Bigg|_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\\&=\dfrac{\pi}{2\sqrt{2}}\ln\left(3+2\sqrt{2}\right).\end{aligned}\]

questions.question:
Fie \(x_n \gt 0\), \(n \in \mathbb{N}^*\), astfel ca
 \(\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty} \left(\dfrac{x_{n+1}}{x_n}\right)^n \lt 1\).
 Atunci \(\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty} x_n = 0\).
questions.author: Mircea Ivan
questions.hint: Mai general, fie \(x_n,a_n\gt 0,\ n\in\mathbb{N}^*\), astfel ca \(\displaystyle \sum_{n\geq 1}\dfrac{1}{a_n}=\infty\) și \[\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(\dfrac{x_{n+1}}{x_n}\right)^{a_n}\lt 1.\] Să demonstrăm că \(\displaystyle \lim_{n\to\infty}x_n=0\). Fie \(0\lt q\lt 1\) și \(p\in\mathbb{N}^*\) astfel ca \[\left(\dfrac{x_{n+1}}{x_n}\right)^{a_n}\lt q,\quad n\geq p.\] Rezultă \[x_{n+1}\lt x_p\,q^{\frac{1}{a_p}+\cdots+\frac{1}{a_n}},\quad n\geq p,\] de unde \(x_n\to 0\).
